about.description: Mineral Vault tokenizes mineral and royalty-style interests, aiming to provide liquid exposure to cash-flowing energy and mineral assets that are typically difficult to access. The product is structured around portfolio-style ownership economics, where returns are driven by underlying production-linked income streams rather than crypto market beta, and it emphasizes passive participation with managed asset administration.
about.registryInfo: United States limited liability company, MINERAL VAULT LLC is organized in Texas with entity number 0805439628 and holds Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) 254900TTJZB6YL9WQN66. It sponsors Mineral Vault structures whose tokens represent interests in underlying oil and gas royalty assets.
